about: The official 55-trophy list as PlayStation publishes it (names, descriptions and grades), with an original guide and named sources for every trophy, written for this entry.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum is the capstone: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to hunt for it. Work the list in the order the roadmap view lays out — the story first, taking the missable moments as they appear, then the character strands, one pass at every activity, the collectible sweep and the counted grinds — and this one falls last, by itself.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the campaign. It plays out as part of the introduction, so simply start the story and play the first mission through to its end; no preparation or side work is needed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission that belongs to Chapter 1. Story chapters complete in order as you follow the mission markers on the map, so keep playing the campaign and this unlocks as the chapter's final cutscene plays.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission that belongs to Chapter 2. It opens right after Chapter 1 closes; keep following the story markers and the trophy lands when the chapter's last mission wraps up.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission that belongs to Chapter 3. As with the earlier chapters there is nothing to prepare in advance — play the campaign missions in order and the chapter trophy unlocks at its finale.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission that belongs to Chapter 4. By this point the map and most activities are open, but the chapter itself is a straight run of story missions; follow them through and it unlocks at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the game's final mission, which only opens once the earlier chapters are done. Before you start it, clear the one-time moments listed on the Watch-outs page — the ending locks those scenes away — then play the finale through and the story's gold trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It appears as part of the campaign; head to its marker when it shows up and play it through to the final objective.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is one of the campaign's set-piece jobs, reached in story order; finish its last objective and the trophy unlocks with the mission complete screen.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named story missions it arrives in campaign order — play it from its marker to the end and this is awarded.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Follow the campaign to its marker, finish every objective the mission sets, and the trophy lands as the mission closes.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the campaign's airport job. While you are at VCIA for the story, keep the missable Catch Me If You Can in mind — its one-time chance belongs to this same stretch of the game.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is reached in campaign order like the other named missions; play it through to the final objective and the trophy is awarded.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's own completion counter. That means the full story, every character strand finished, each activity tried, the collectible sets done and the counted feats ground out. The tracker on the main page mirrors those same buckets, so when nearly everything else here is ticked, compare the in-game percentage and chase whatever line is still short.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total. Stunt jumps and stunt events all over Leonida feed the same counter and the game keeps the running total, so work through the stunt locations methodically instead of repeating a favourite — the variety also fills in the map for The Goodtime State.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every one of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, the shooting range, drone racing, races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the WAiNK photo spots. One visit to each is enough for this trophy; the activity trophies around it then ask you to master them one by one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge scores accuracy and speed, so slow down for clean hits rather than spraying: a tidy run beats a fast sloppy one. Work through the ranges one weapon at a time and replay any challenge that lands silver until it turns gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Give every course one learning run first — the winning time gets much easier once you know where the tight gates sit — then fly it for real and move to the next location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeats of the same event do not add to the count, so travel around the map and take each race once; the wins also sharpen your driving for the harder late-game events.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the benchmark angler of the fishing activity: enter the challenge against him, hook and land your catch cleanly, and finish ahead of his score to take the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish. Any cabinet counts, so pick the shortest game on offer, play a full run of it to the end, and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Andy's strand is a chain of missions that opens up across the story; take each one as its icon appears and finish the chain — the last mission in it awards this trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Work through Kenton's strand mission by mission as the markers appear during the campaign; the closing mission of the chain is the one that pays this out.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Billy's strand unfolds alongside the story, so keep an eye out for his markers between campaign missions and finish the chain to its last job.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as question-mark icons on the map — take them as they appear instead of saving them for after the story, because some strangers are only around during certain story stretches, which is what makes this missable. Eight finished strands, not eight single missions, is what the trophy counts.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Follow Randy's strand from its first marker to the last; the closing mission of his chain awards the trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Tyrone's strand plays out across the campaign in stages; finish each stage as it appears and the final mission in the chain unlocks this.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. The spots sit at scenic points around the state; visit each one and use the meditation prompt there. They double as scouting stops — many sit near collectibles, so sweep the area while you are there.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's hunting strand points at one rare animal — follow his clues to its territory, track it quietly, and take the shot cleanly. Take Bret's missions as they come rather than leaving them for the post-game, because his strand is tied to story progress and the chance can pass, which is what makes this missable.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered all over Leonida and a set only counts when every card in it is found, so pick up any card you pass and use the collection screen to see which sets are closest to finished before hunting down the stragglers.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 locations. The WAiNK photo spots are spread across the whole state and one stop at each marked location counts, so fold them into the collectible road trip instead of making a hundred separate journeys.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's challenges. Challenges are the short scored tasks dotted around the map and the menus, and they pile up naturally while you work on activities and collectibles — late in the run, open the challenge list and mop up whichever quick ones are left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it without getting caught. Partner stretches are limited to certain story missions and hangout moments, which is what makes this missable — do it while a partner is actually with you: grab a fast car, break line of sight, hide until the stars drain, and escape clean.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, keeping your wanted level alive between them. Plan a tight triangle of nearby shops before you start: hit one, move straight to the next without letting the stars fully drain, and finish the third the same way. Like Hot Together it needs a partner present, so use a co-op story stretch — that is what makes it missable.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle counts the first time you get into it, so swap cars constantly as you travel — parked cars, traffic and mission vehicles all add up, and the total comes quickly if you never take the same car twice.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a crowded fight, trigger Combat Focus when at least five enemies are within reach, and drop them before the effect ends — a packed shootout during the story is the easiest stage for it.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in plain terms, leave the airport in a way the schedule never planned, by taking an aircraft outside of a story-scripted flight. The chance belongs to the VCIA stretch of the story, so try it while the airport is part of the campaign rather than after the ending; that one-time window is what makes it missable.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The jokey description hides a simple ask: deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. When a Rhino shows up, disable or destroy it instead of running; heavy weapons and shots to the rear do the work. Armour shows up in the late story and in free roam at high wanted levels.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, go in quiet, keep the alarm from tripping and be gone before anyone raises it — if the detection meter fills, restart the attempt rather than forcing it.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape cleanly each time. Vault jobs are the heavy end of the robbery ladder: bring people you trust, open the vault, and have the getaway route planned before the first alarm sounds — an escape only counts once the heat is fully lost.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The trucks run set routes; hit one away from crowds, crack the rear doors, take the cash and lose the response — the same rhythm as the vault jobs, in miniature.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in area by area as you travel, so the collectible road trip does most of this for free — near the end, compare the map against the area count and visit any grey patch that is left.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own operations on its own turf, so this is the same robbery nine times spread across the map — keep your own note of which gangs are done, because the game only shows the running total.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a small one-time scene rather than a challenge: while the story is around Ocean Beach, take the moment when it is offered — a drink at the beach spot with the view. It is easy to walk straight past, and once the story moves on the moment does not come back, which is what makes it missable.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight out through the showroom glass. The opportunity belongs to one specific story beat inside the showroom; when the scene puts you in the car with the glass in front of you, floor it instead of looking for the door. Miss that beat and it is gone, which is what makes it missable.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley: play a game of bowling there. Visit the alley, start a match and play it to the last frame — a win is not required, completing the game is the follow-through the trophy wants.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is coy — a partnership with mass appeal — and the trophy hangs on a partner moment the story offers once: a shared scene with your partner that plays out in front of a crowd. When the story sets the scene up, take part in it fully instead of skipping the activity; it does not repeat once the story moves past it, which is what makes it missable.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — the game counts them, and PlayStation tracks the total up to 500. Dialogue picks, mission approaches and free-roam decisions all feed the counter, so it fills in on its own across a full playthrough; if it is still short at the end, quick repeatable decisions in free roam top it up.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try: fail an attempt at something, then succeed at the same thing right after. A challenge or race you miss once and then clear is the natural place; if it never happens by accident, deliberately muff a quick challenge and immediately redo it cleanly.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Leonida hides odd little events off the beaten path, and this unlocks when you stumble onto one of them. Exploring remote spots at night — the same road trip that fills in the map — gives you the best chance of seeing one.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and connect. Pick a slow street, ride alongside your target at a moderate speed and swing as you pass — go too fast and you overshoot the swing entirely.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies; pass them to your laundering contacts instead of spending them raw and the laundered total climbs with every job — the vault and armored-truck scores feed it fastest.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in total. Clothes, vehicles, weapons and services all count toward it, so ordinary play does most of the work; the garage properties and late-game shopping finish it off without trying.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages come up for sale around the state as the story opens new areas; buy each one as it lists. They earn their keep as storage while you work through the 100-vehicle discovery run.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you take a vehicle you like, register it in the app before moving on — ten registrations is a small ask spread across the whole game, so start early instead of grinding it at the end.
